treatments.photorealistic: documentary photojournalism photograph, reportage realism, 35mm lens at eye level, natural available light, true-to-life proportions, authentic textures, shallow depth of field, reportage palette of crimson red, warm amber and deep teal, wide composition with generous negative space, magazine cover quality
treatments.caricature: bold editorial illustration blending digital painting with flat vector infographic elements, exaggerated characters and oversized symbolic objects, rich saturated colour palette of crimson red, warm yellow and deep teal, bold cinematic lighting, visible texture, poster composition, magazine cover quality

visual_prompts.treatment_rules: The photorealistic treatment is the default: use it when the column reports concrete, recognisable facts — a place, an event, an object, a person, a scene — that can be shown as one plausible documentary photograph. Use the caricature treatment only when the column is abstract: an argument, an economic or institutional trend, a metaphor or a critique with no single scene that can be documented.
visual_prompts.negative_prompt: watermark, signature, logo, brand marks, ui elements, screenshots, deepfake, fabricated news scene, staged reenactment, uncanny realistic face, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, paragraphs of text, walls of small text, misspelled words, gibberish letters, desaturated, monochrome, grayscale, washed-out colors, dull grey palette, flat unlit shading, unfinished sketch
